scope: Supervision/CLI/observed-contract qualification; no native model performance from these checks.

discovery.modeLimit: Swift Testing intentionally enumerates all tests even with --filter; this is discovery only.

processOwnership.ownershipIdentity: PID plus process creation time; no command/environment sweep

runtime: Matching Xcode MacOSX platform Testing/XCTest framework, private framework and support library paths; no SwiftPM planning/cache/build.

processSupervision.identity: full PID plus process creation time, including root exclusion
processSupervision.cleanup: direct child reaped; tracked descendants stopped/confirmed nonexecuting before final log/result digest; unexpected observed children fail closed
processSupervision.limits: Known in-process helper supervision, not an OS sandbox against arbitrary fork/double-fork code.
processSupervision.independentReview: PID-reuse identity-double regression exposed and fixed; second source review clear.

observedContract: New final paired cohort requires explicit checkpointWritesDrained=true and finite consistent quiescenceCompletionSeconds/TPS/receiptToQuiescenceMilliseconds. Historical cohorts retain original field definitions and are not upgraded.

rateDefinitions.generationTPS: (completed output IDs - all IDs in first output event)/(last-first native output event)
rateDefinitions.endToEndTPS: completed output IDs/native terminal duration; current COMPLETE publication already precedes terminal delivery
rateDefinitions.receiptCompletionTPS: completed output IDs/return of session.complete, separate literal receipt timestamp
rateDefinitions.quiescenceCompletionTPS: completed output IDs/explicit post-receipt idle plus owned checkpoint writer/activity joins; no fsync durability or saturation claim

limits: Actual filtered suite invocation and full-model results belong to root-owned native cohort.
No provisional, failed or result-digest-mismatched arm may enter qualified three-pair comparisons.
Exact within-arm and four-role cross-policy output parity is required; no raw output fingerprint is exported.
privacy: No local paths, prompts, generated IDs/output fingerprints, raw logprobs or provider/account identifiers.
